name: Ojou-sama wa Iinari Mitai Desu!?
original_name: お嬢様はイイナリみたいです!?
source:
"Please! Use your ero power to make that uptight student council completely obedient!"

It's been a few years since I last came back to Japan, and my childhood friend Yuuri asked me to do just that.
Apparently, the co-ed system that started this year is already on the verge of being scrapped, all thanks to the student council's opposition.
So, when I ask Yuuri for the details, the way to make them obey is to beat them in an erotic showdown and get them to admit they felt good.
As expected of Yuuri! She really gets me!
So she's already set everything up, huh? Good job!
Turning those young ladies into "obedient" girls, meaning obedient enough to never refuse anything lewd, what a beautiful ring to that!..
This is a challenge with some seriously promising possibilities.
But, for all my enthusiasm, when I marched in and started messing with the ladies, I got easily driven back. They're way tougher than I expected!

"Damn! You obviously came earlier! And yet you have the nerve to say it didn't feel good?!"

Just as I was racking my brain for a way to conquer them, I found a stash of naughty toys in the school attic.
And then, one after another, I kept finding more and more of them.
Why the heck are there so many sex toys? For the time being, I put that question aside.
There's no way I'm letting treasure like this go to waste!
Before the rematch with the young ladies, I decided to try them out on Yuuri first.

[Translated from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE059538.html]the official site[/url]]
